page.overview:
Who is Alicia von Untervald?

Alicia von Unterwald had sought influence at Mundvard’s side from the time he dwelt in Sylvania, centuries before the Glottkin arrived. Immortality brings great perspective, and Alicia was content to marshal her own armies in the dark and forgotten spaces of the city port until the time was ripe to strike. Even the patience of vampires can fray, however. Alicia was only too pleased to hear of the city’s invasion, for it had been too long since she wet her fangs in anger.
